description: The complete friction record for a slug: status, dates, confidence, severity, time cost, categories, channels, license context, error codes/messages, dated evidence list, and the six body sections as markdown (symptom checklist, cause, fix with solution classes, verification steps, fallback, prevention). Cite the returned URL; a German version exists at the german_version URL.

locale.description: Output and citation language. English fallback when a current German translation is unavailable.
